subject: Why is it impossible to Ctrl+C plots?

messages.author: fbcfedba2abc5340
messages.subject: Why is it impossible to Ctrl+C plots?
parts:
Hey all,

I love ggplot, but the one frustration I find with it is that when I
accidentally try to make a plot I shouldn't have (geom_point with
millions of points), it will take forever to plot, and if I try to
cancel the command with Ctrl+C it doesn't respond either, and I have
to wait over a minute to get command control again. Is there any way
to fix that?

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Why is it impossible to Ctrl+C plots?
parts:
It's a bit complicated - the problem is that when a plot errors out R
deparses all of the calls so it can create a traceback. Due to some
unfortunate combination of proto and bad programming, ggplot2 calls
contain the entire dataset, and deparsing it takes some time.

Hadley
